newsitem.title: UK: LEP freight volume MidEast ex-Europe up 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: LEP freight volume MidEast ex-Europe up 25 pct.

text.p: Forwarder LEP International said its freight volumes to the Middle East from Europe increased by 25 percent during first half 1997 whilst those from North America to the Middle East rose by 13 percent.

The increase in its freight volumes in the Middle East has been equally spread between air and ocean freight with particular strong growth to Saudi Arabia and Lebanon, said Don Clarke, LEP's regional manager, Middle East.

The company overall has seen an increase of four million stg in ocean freight revenue and two million stg in airfreight during the first six months of 1997, he added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
